name: War-Awoken Deadly Whip (Weapon Skill)
name_jp: 戦醒ペリッシュウィップ
effects:
Single-target Ice/NE piercing magic attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & ATB Speed x1.2 to Ice Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold with at least 0/2 En-Ice members
WS Blue: Dualcast Ice 3, Instant Ice 3 & Weakness Damage +30% for 3 turns to user
WS Gold: Dualcast Ice 2, Instant Ice 2 & Weakness Damage +30% for 2 turns to all allies
